description.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. This is a pipe trench or a short pipeline placement. Read it in the Xingtai table. Use this row when the site has no pump-motor supply. Taken from the printed row: The catalogue prints 40 kW on the tractor-driven machine. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Tractor-Driven 4100 at 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 15 MPa, 40–100 m horizontal / 15–45 m vertical, aggregate 1–3 cm, hopper 0.25 m³, slump 180–220 mm, 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm and 1300 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The machine is tractor-driven. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not move the same condition onto Rural Self-Built House Diesel Pump, which prints diesel 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 15 MPa, horizontal 30–50 m, vertical 10–30 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, hopper 0.2 m³, 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm and 800 kg. Taken from the printed row: The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. Keep this cell as published. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This note names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
description.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。这是管沟或一段较短的管道浇筑。现场没有泵用电机电源时用这一行。目录在拖拉机带动的机器上印了 40 kW。邢台河北品锦机械把拖拉机带动4100列为40 kW、6–12 m³/h、15 MPa、水平 40–100 m / 垂直 15–45 m、骨料 1–3 cm、料斗 0.25 m³、坍落度 180–220 mm、外形 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm、1300 kg。这台是拖拉机带动。不要把同一工况挪到农村自建房柴油泵，那一行印的是柴油机 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、15 MPa、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m、骨料 1–3 cm、料斗 0.2 m³、外形 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm、800 kg。这张照片来自一篇公开文章，只作这类工况的参照。它不是品锦的合同记录。本页不写项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。
